resources.string: Refresh the stock BYD weather display using MET Norway when its refresh button is tapped.
GPS first, with automatic Wi-Fi/cell fallback when available.
In DiLink, allow BYD Weather to auto-start and run in the background.
Select BYD Weather refresh button in Accessibility settings. It observes only taps in BYD WeatherData so its refresh button can also update MET Norway forecasts.

Hourly and seven-day forecasts use MET Norway. Times follow the car’s time zone. Today’s high and low use available forecast hours, including earlier hours saved by this app.\n\nVisibility is unavailable; the stock detail screen may show −1. UV is a clear-sky forecast. Air quality covers Norway only, and its health-risk index appears here after an update. The stock air-quality category remains unavailable because it uses a different scale.
